subject: Kickoff: dataset distillation (KIP) as a data-platform service
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the dataset-distillation track for the data-platforms portfolio. The core tech is the Kernel Inducing Points (KIP) and Label Solve (LS) algorithms from our open-source release — meta-learn a tiny synthetic training set from kernel ridge-regression, so downstream teams can iterate on models against a few hundred distilled examples instead of hauling full corpora around. Two product angles: fast CI-style training loops, and a data-minimization story for datasets we'd rather not replicate broadly.

Milestones (Apr 20 - Jul 27):
- May 22: reproduce the released distilled-set results using the infinitely-wide ConvNet kernels; finite ConvNet transfer check
- Jun 19: distill one internal tabular corpus end to end, quality delta documented
- Jul 20: platform integration readout — distilled sets as first-class Corpus artifacts

Bao — resourcing please. Kernel computations at this scale are not cheap, so let's get the compute ask right early.

Dmitri
